summary: Consolidated the duplicated Claude-labelled reference-adapter logic in scripts/claude_code_intake_adapter.py into a shared, producer-neutral helper in src/pcae/core/intake.py (build_intake_candidate_from_files, derive_producer_provenance, parse_file_change_spec, current_head_commit, compute_content_hash) and a new pcae intake from-files CLI command. Selected agent_core.read_agent_lock(root) (.pcae/agent-lock.json) as the producer-provenance source over the narrower six-name backend/session lock, because it accepts arbitrary caller-supplied identities and is the governance-session-scoped artifact every bootstrapped session already has, not an execution/backend-oriented one. Mechanically mapped and documented (without unifying) the three distinct agent-identity vocabularies: the static capability registry (claude-local/codex-local/pcae-native/kimi-local/deepseek-local/gemini-local/grok-local/perplexity-local), the governance agent lock (accepts any string), and the backend/session lock (claude-local/claude-deepseek/claude-kimi/codex/manual/noop) -- confirming the codex-local vs codex mismatch named in the handoff is real. Producer provenance is derived from the active lock when present (producer.source=agent_lock) and requires an explicit --producer when absent (producer.source=candidate, never invented as unknown), preserving v0.3's external/unbootstrapped compatibility. A conflicting explicit --producer against an active lock is rejected deterministically before any repo work happens; a matching one is not treated as a conflict. Proved Codex and a wholly custom agent identity work through the identical generic path with no dedicated adapter, and that ALLOW/DENY outcomes and authority fields (execution_allowed/promotion_executed) are identical regardless of producer, including when the producer object itself carries injected authority-looking keys. Proved the governance lock's own active_task/git_branch snapshot fields are never substituted for canonical task-scope or base-commit authority (both are re-derived live on every candidate). Reduced scripts/claude_code_intake_adapter.py to a thin subprocess wrapper around pcae intake from-files with zero intake-contract logic of its own -- no more hardcoded claude-code producer.kind. Added 24 new focused tests (tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_2w_producer_provenance_integration.py) and updated 3 tests in the existing 2U.2 suite plus 3 in 2U.3 (script internals retired, one grep allowlist extended for the new reviewed git rev-parse call).
